<$voicel(1,3)><$facial(1,9)>I’d resigned myself to being alone in this world forever...
<$voicel(1,9)><$facial(1,1)>But thanks to you, <$cdef(27)>, it seems
Pokémon
are
coming back!
<$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,1)>I really can’t thank you enough.
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,23)>And as a token of my gratitude, I have a present for you.

<$voicel(1,9)><$facial(1,4)>Ta-da!
<$voicel(1,6)>What do you think?

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)>Hohoho! This isn’t the type of thing you can carry around
in your bag.
<$voicel(1,5)>It’s called a “chair.” Humans used to sit on these <$voicel(1,6)><$facial(1,1)>when
they were tired.
<$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,4)>Since you’ve been running around all this time in the
shape of a human, I thought it would be perfect for you!

<$voicel(1,7)>I actually used to live with a human myself, a looong, long
time ago.
<$voicel(1,5)>This chair belonged to that human, so it’s got a lot of
memories attached to it.
<$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,4)>It’s a hair small for me to use, though, so I’m giving it
to you. <$voicel(1,10)>Please take good care of it.
You used <$cdef(27)>Stockpile</color>!

<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,4)>Wha—?! Were you even listening to me?! Chairs are
NOT food!

<$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,803)>Well, I’ll be... So you can store items inside your body, eh?
<$comeff(1,9)><$voicel(1,10)><$motion(1,801)>Seems like a mighty handy skill to have!
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,7)>Would you mind <$cdef(27)>placing that chair down around here?
<$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,824)>Could you <$cdef(27)>put the chair down over here</color>, please?

<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,802)>You sure set that chair down awfully far away. It’d be
easier to chat if you put it a bit closer.
<$voicel(1,8)><$facial(1,4)>Now then, go ahead and <$cdef(27)>sit on the chair</color>.
<$voicel(1,6)>You know, I think I’ll take a bit of a rest too.
<$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,38)>Go ahead and sit on the chair.

<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,806)><$comeff(1,17)>Phew... It’s been ages since I’ve talked this much. I’ve
gone and tired myself out.

<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,23)><$motion(1,807)>Brrr...
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)><$motion(1,661)>It’s a bit chilly now that the sun’s gone down.

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,827)>You know, humans made handy tools to keep both heat
and cold at bay.

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,3)>It looks like you’re better at transforming into a human
than you are at transforming into Pokémon...
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Maybe that means you’ll be just as good as a human at
making fancy tools too.

<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,38)>Hohoho!
<$voicel(1,5)>If you could use that special power of yours to create
more nice places for Pokémon to live, <$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,668)>that would really
warm my heart!

<$voicel(3,7)><$emotion(3,9)>’Scuse me, can I tell you something? I found something
weird!
<$voicel(3,7)><$comeff(3,3)><$motion(3,801)>Follow me!

<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,10)>Hohoho! What do you suppose <$cdef(27)>Bulbasaur’s found?
<$voicel(1,6)>Why not go along with them and see?
<$voicel(3,8)><$comeff(3,3)>This way!
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,802)>Brrr! It’s so cold...
<$voicel(3,9)><$comeff(3,10)><$motion(3,801)>See? This thing! What do you think it is?
<$voicel(3,7)><$facial(3,4)>I think it’s...hmmm...<wait(0.4)><$comeff(3,3)>a bed for napping!

This is a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(764)>.
You can make all kinds of items here as long as you’ve
learned the <$cdef(27)>recipe!
<$voicel(3,8)><$comeff(3,6)><$motion(3,803)>Huh? You’re gonna make something here?
<$voicel(3,9)><$comeff(3,3)><$motion(3,801)>Wow, that’s sooo cool! Um...what is it?
<$voicel(3,4)><$emotion(3,29)>Do you think the <$cdef(27)>professor</color>’ll know?

<$voicel(3,9)><$emotion(3,32)>Come on, let’s go show that <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1280)> you made to
the <$cdef(27)>professor!

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,3)>My word, is that...a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1280)>?
<$motion(1,801)>Thank you so much—just as I was really starting to shiver!
<$voicel(1,6)>Could you set it down here?
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,802)>Please bring the <$cdef(27)><fqty(1)><$ifull(1280)> </color>just a touch closer.
<$voicel(3,9)><$comeff(3,6)><$motion(3,803)>Hey, <$cdef(27)>Professor</color>, what IS this thing?

<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,824)>This here is called a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1280)>.
<$voicel(1,5)>It makes the area bright and warm. <$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,805)>Brrr!
<$voicel(3,7)><$motion(3,803)>Huh. But it’s not very warm, is it?

<$voicel(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,827)>Quite right. Now that I think about it, the fire’s not
actually lit. <$motion(1,654)>A <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1280)> needs fire!

<$voicel(1,1)><$emotion(1,17)>But it could be a wee bit challenging for us to start a fire
on our own...

<$voicel(3,5)><$emotion(3,48)>I know somebody who can spit out fire! ...I haven’t seen
them around here, though.

<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,801)>Oho! You’ve got a friend who can do that, have you?
<$voicel(1,7)>What sort of place did they live in?

<$voicel(3,7)><$motion(3,803)><$comeff(3,3)>Well, um, you know the plot of tall grass that
<$cdef(27)>
made
for
me?
<$voicel(3,10)>It
was
like that!

<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,824)>Say, <$cdef(27)>, why don’t you make
<$cdef(27)>another
plot
of
tall
grass,
<$voicel(1,6)>like
the
home
you
made
for <$cdef(27)>Bulbasaur?
<$voicel(1,5)>A Pokémon who can make fire might come by if you do.

<$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,7)>Could you please make <$cdef(27)>another plot of tall grass, like the
home you made for <$cdef(27)>Bulbasaur?
<$voicel(1,9)>A Pokémon who can make fire might come by if you do.
<$voicel(3,4)><$emotion(3,3)>Aww, the <$cdef(27)>professor </color>looks so cold.
<$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>Huh? You want me to light a <$cdef(27)><fqty(1)><$ifull(1280)></color>?
<$voicel(4,10)><$emotion(4,1)>Sure thing! Stuff like that’s no problem for me!
<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,3)>Just take me to the <$cdef(27)><fqty(1)><$ifull(1280)></color> and watch me shine!
<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,3)>Take me to that <$cdef(27)><fqty(1)><$ifull(1280)></color>!

<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh, a <$cdef(27)>Charmander’s here to help, eh?
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,801)>Then lead <$cdef(27)>Charmander to the <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1280)>!
<$voicel(3,9)><$emotion(3,14)>Oh, yay! It’s <$cdef(27)>Charmander</color>! Take them to the <$cdef(27)><fqty(1)><$ifull(1280)></color>!
<$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,9)>How’s that? I lit the fire for you!

<$emotion(1,22)><$comeff(1,10)><$voicel(1,9)>Oho! With that, the <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1280)> is complete! Thank you,
<$cdef(27)>Charmander! <$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,806)>What a welcome warmth!

<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,661)>Now that it’s gotten dark, why don’t we call it a day and
get some rest? <$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,1)><$facial(1,4)>Thank you for the help, everyone—truly!

<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,827)>By the by, I noticed you’ve been transformed into a human
this whole time.
<$voicel(1,7)>Could it be that you really miss the human you look like?

<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,654)>Mm-hmm. I understand. <$motion(1,824)>A long time ago... A very looong
time ago...<$voicel(1,6)>there was a human I spent all my time with.
<$voicel(1,9)>Beloved by everyone—humans and Pokémon alike.
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,826)>I don’t know. But I do have a theory.

<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,824)>You’ve started creating some comfortable habitats for
Pokémon, and as a result, <$voicel(1,8)>they’ve begun coming back
here, right?
<$voicel(1,5)>I’d wager that it’ll work the same for humans.

<$voicel(1,7)>Humans and Pokémon once lived happily together here.
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(4,619)>If this world grows beautiful again, like it was back then...
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,23)><$motion(0,219)>I expect the humans will eventually return here as well.
<$voicel(1,8)>Mark my words.<$motion(1,656)>

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)><$facial(1,4)>You know, now that we’ve got so many Pokémon back here
again, <$voicel(1,6)>I think I’ll share some stories about the old days.
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,824)><$facial(1,14)><$motion(0,347)>Back when I was just a child... ... ...and the humans... ... ...
then Pokémon... ... ...<$voicel(1,6)>was such a help!<$motion(1,652)>
<$voicel(1,4)><$facial(1,9)><$kfacial(1)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>Are you listening?
<$voicel(3,9)><$emotion(3,1)>Yay, I had so much fun playing today!

<$voicel(3,5)><$emotion(3,3)>But I’m a little hungry now! Do you have a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(2340)>
or anything?

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,2)>Why don’t you try watering an area where there’s a lot of
dry tall grass in one place?

<$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,801)>If the dry grass can be restored to fresh, green tall grass,
<$voicel(1,9)>it might help refresh my own memory about what
it was like when Pokémon lived here long ago.
You <wait(0.8)><$facial(1,13)>swallowed the <$cdef(27)><fqty(1)><$ifull(1985)></color>.

<$voicel(3,5)><$emotion(3,14)>Yeah, <$cdef(27)>Tangrowth seems really smart, and they’re all tangly
and messy <$voicel(3,4)><$facial(3,4)>like a <$cdef(27)>professor, right?
<$voicel(3,9)><$emotion(3,8)>So let’s show that <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1280)> to <$cdef(27)>Professor Tangrowth!

<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,1)>If you can use that move, <$cdef(27)>you should be able to smash
the rocks and ground around here.

If you talk to a Pokémon and select “Follow me!,” that
Pokémon will follow you around!
You can also press <$keyicon(214)> while standing next to a Pokémon
to get them to follow you!
Try crafting something!
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,38)>I think this is a bed for napping!

This is a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(764)>.
You can make all kinds of items here as long as you’ve
learned the <$cdef(27)>recipe!
Try crafting something!

<$voicel(3,9)><$comeff(3,10)>Whoa, that surprised me! I guess it’s not a napping bed
after all.
<$voicel(3,5)>...<$emotion(3,16)>Huh? There’s something stuck in there.
You got some <$cdef(27)>simple wooden DIY recipes</color>!

Try making something with the <$cdef(27)>recipes you got.
You might be able to make something that can warm up
chilly Pokémon!

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh, you’ve already revived some tall grass?
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>Let’s wait a bit and see what happens.
